svg.title: README-AI Core Ribbon Mark
svg.desc: Isolated brand vector glyph of the README-AI notched bookmark ribbon with spectral gradient and pure transform motion.

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Isolate the fundamental brand geometry completely free of containers, backgrounds, tiles, or framing borders for universal micro-icon or header placement.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Centered the canonical notch polygon (-64,-74 to 64,74) on coordinate origin with a fitted viewbox. Mapped the authentic tri-stop linear gradient (#4169E1 -> #7B3DE3 -> #8A2BE2) across the diagonal extent. Added a hardware-accelerated CIM pulse with full reduced-motion accessibility.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Stripped all ambient and specular lighting layers to expose the uncluttered structural silhouette.
